mission.heading: The Last Bell
paras: The Paradox Academy stands on a cliff where no two clocks agree. Tonight its Headmaster died, and in ten minutes the Last Bell will ring the end of everything.
You are Wren Hollis, home after thirty lost years, still fifteen. Tock, the old clockwork butler, is at your side.
Find out what started the loop before the clock runs out: ten minutes.

tutorial.title: Look around
tutorial.text: Drag to turn the room. Glowing things can be tapped.

tutorial.title: Tap and take
tutorial.text: Tap a glowing object to look at it, read it or take it. Wren's Logbook keeps everything you find.

tutorial.title: Puzzles
tutorial.text: Each room has one puzzle. Every panel has an X to close it, and you can pause any time.

tutorial.title: Moments, hints and the clock
tutorial.text: You earn Moments for finds and room rewards. Wrong answers cost a few. Tock gives 3 hints in the whole game, at a cost of 25 Moments each. You have 10 minutes.

open.1.t: The Foyer. Everything is exactly as I remember it. Except the clock has stopped.

open.2.t: Welcome home, Miss Wren. It is 9:07, and the Headmaster is gone.

open.3.t: Gone? Tock, why do I feel I've done all this before?

open.4.t: I cannot say, Miss. But the Last Bell rings in ten minutes.

open.5.t: Then we start the clock again. Find me the way, Tock.

r1.enter.1.t: Nine-oh-seven, and nothing moves. The clock first, Tock.

r1.inspect.clock.t: It stopped at the minute he died, Miss.

r1.find.key.t: Tock's own winding key. He's been carrying it all along.

r1.find.gears.t: Six gears, and two empty shafts that need two of them.

r1.wrong.1.t: Hm. The clock coughed, Miss. Maybe a gear does not fit its gap.

r1.wrong.2.t: The brass plate gives each gap as a number. A fitting pair adds up to it.

r1.wrong.3.t: Take the first gap, thirty-six, and take away the twelve already there.

r1.hint.t: Look at the two gap numbers. The teeth must add up to each one.

r1.idle.t: The clock's heart is behind the little brass door, Miss.

r1.right.1.t: It's ticking. Nine-oh-seven is moving again.

r1.right.2.t: And the hour hand has fallen loose, Miss. The Study lock is shaped for it.

r1.right.3.t: Then the Headmaster's last room is next.

r2.enter.1.t: Father's Study. His tea is still warm, Tock.

r2.inspect.cups.t: Two cups, Miss. The Headmaster had a visitor.

r2.find.magnifier.t: His magnifier. Good for looking where nobody looked.

r2.use.rug.t: A boot print. Small. Like a first-year's.

r2.wrong.1.t: Not quite, Miss. Start with who cannot be on the Roof.

r2.wrong.2.t: Two notes talk about the Roof. Together they leave only one sibling.

r2.wrong.3.t: That puts Marlowe on the Roof. The soup note settles Dax next.

r2.hint.t: Begin with the Roof. Only one sibling fits both notes about it.

r2.idle.t: The cork board holds four notes, Miss.

r2.right.1.t: So Marlowe, Isolde, Dax and Bram were all somewhere else.

r2.right.2.t: And yet two cups, Miss, and a boot print under the desk.

r2.right.3.t: Someone else was here at 9:07. Someone my size.

r3.enter.1.t: Marlowe's perch. He could watch the stars for hours.

r3.enter.2.t: Tempus rises over the courtyard, Miss. The Headmaster's own star.

r3.find.eyepiece.t: A little brass eyepiece. It fits the great telescope.

r3.inspect.compass.t: North is the brass owl, Miss. Everything else counts from there.

r3.wrong.1.t: Close, Miss, but not true. Read the star chart's two rules again.

r3.wrong.2.t: The chart wants the Foyer clock's hour, times fifteen, for the bearing.

r3.wrong.3.t: Nine hours, fifteen degrees each. The height is seven children, five each.

r3.hint.t: Two rules on the chart. One uses the Foyer clock, one counts the children.

r3.idle.t: The eyepiece is on the bench, Miss.

r3.right.1.t: There's something scratched on the rail. "Wren, do not save him."

r3.right.2.t: I cannot say what it means, Miss.

r3.right.3.t: Neither can I. But that is my handwriting.

r4.enter.1.t: Seven beds, and one of them is mine. It still has my name.

r4.inspect.bed.t: Eleven marks, Miss. Miss Tansy was counting something.

r4.find.fuse.t: A fuse for the Night-Watch board.

r4.learn.plate.t: Always first the Bell, then the Key, Miss.

r4.nudge.1.t: Each switch flips itself and the lamps beside, above and below it.

r4.nudge.2.t: Try pressing fewer switches. Each one has to earn its place.

r4.nudge.3.t: Look at the top row first, Miss, then the rest.

r4.hint.t: Four presses are enough. Think of the top row and the left lamp.

r4.idle.t: The tin of fuses is on the shelf, Miss.

r4.right.1.t: Every lamp lit, just as the Headmaster liked it.

r4.right.2.t: Miss Tansy left you a page, under her pillow.

r4.right.3.t: Eleven times. She wrote that she saw me pull him out, eleven times.

r5.enter.1.t: The Lab. It smells of cold metal and old thunderstorms.

r5.learn.recipe.t: Exactly four drams, Miss. The Headmaster was strict about it.

r5.inspect.bottle.t: The initials on this label are W.H., Miss.

r5.find.handle.t: The tap's handle. Someone took it off on purpose.

r5.wrong.1.t: Not four drams yet, Miss. The recipe is very strict.

r5.wrong.2.t: You get exact amounts by pouring one vial into the other until it is full.

r5.wrong.3.t: Fill the big vial, pour into the small one, and look at what is left behind.

r5.hint.t: Fill the big vial, pour into the small one. What is left?

r5.idle.t: The tap needs its handle, Miss.

r5.right.1.t: Four drams, to the drop. The mist has frozen in the air.

r5.right.2.t: And the label says W.H., Miss. Those are your initials.

r5.right.3.t: I brewed this. Or I will. Or I already have.

r6.enter.1.t: The Vault of Hours. Every drawer is stamped with a date.

r6.inspect.drawers.t: This drawer is open and empty, and it carries tonight's date.

r6.find.lantern.t: The lantern's still lit. The vault ring will need it.

r6.learn.ledger.t: Eleven entries, Miss, all signed W.H., all at 9:07.

r6.wrong.1.t: Not yet, Miss. Use the clues from the Observatory, the Dormitory and the Lab.

r6.wrong.2.t: Four symbols are possible, and a gold ring tells you which ones are home.

r6.wrong.3.t: The Bell goes before the Key, and the Eye is never first.

r6.hint.t: Rule out the Sun and the Moon. Then count your gold rings.

r6.idle.t: The lantern lights the ring, Miss.

r6.right.1.t: Eleven times, in my own hand. Tonight is the twelfth.

r6.right.2.t: The Paradox Engine is in the Clock Tower, Miss. That is where it all started.

r6.right.3.t: Then that is where it ends.

r7.enter.1.t: The Clock Tower. This is where it all began, Tock.

r7.enter.2.t: It is, Miss. There is much I have not said.

r7.find.record.t: A record, left on the sill. Whose voice is this?

r7.use.record.1.t: Wren, the first time, you froze the Study when he fell. That frozen second is the Bell.

r7.use.record.2.t: Every try since has only stretched it. I am sorry.

r7.inspect.plate.t: A rule, Miss. Never rest a larger moment on a smaller one.

r7.illegal.1.t: A larger ring cannot rest on a smaller one, Miss.

r7.illegal.2.t: Move the smallest ring first, and keep moving it.

r7.illegal.3.t: The Second helps every other ring travel.

r7.hint.t: Move the Second out of the way. Then the next ring can go.

r7.idle.t: The hour hand fits the Engine's socket, Miss.

r7.right.1.t: The Engine is still. The Bell is held at the edge of ringing.

r7.right.2.t: Miss Wren, I must tell you. I wrote every warning in your Logbook. You asked me to.

r7.right.4.t: Eleven times, Miss. I am so very sorry.

r7.right.5.t: Then let me finish it properly.

endA.1.t: Goodbye, Father. I should have said it the first time.

endA.2.t: The Logbook is blank, Miss. You will not remember tonight.

endA.3.t: Then keep it for me, Tock.

endA.4.t: The Bell stays silent. Dawn finds seven beds, six sleepers and one smiling girl who cannot say why.

endA.5.t: Miss Hollis? The Bureau of Hours would like a word about thirty lost years.

endB.1.t: Stay with me, Father, for as long as the clock lets us.

endB.2.t: The Bell cannot ring, Miss. But nothing will ever move on.

endB.3.t: Frost spreads through the Academy. Only Wren, Tock and one pocket-watch still tick.

endB.5.t: You froze a moment on purpose, Miss Hollis. The Bureau has waited a long time for that.

hint.none.t: I have no hints left, Miss.

hint.poor.t: Not enough Moments, Miss. A hint costs 25 Moments.

credits.whisper.t: Wren, there is a thirteenth hour.

C3.title: Tansy's Diary Page

V2.title: Night-Watch rule

C5.title: Vault ledger
C5.text: Eleven entries signed W.H., every one at 9:07.

C6.title: Corvin's recording

C7.title: Engine plate
C7.text: Never rest a larger ring on a smaller one.

T1.title: Compass ring
T1.text: Bearings start at North, where the brass owl stands.

T2.title: Tansy's headboard
T2.text: Eleven tick marks are scratched on Tansy's headboard.

T3.title: Warm cup
T3.text: The second cup is warm and half drunk.

T4.title: Empty drawer
T4.text: One drawer is open and empty. It carries tonight's date.

people.name: Marlowe
people.line: Loves the stars. Spends most nights in the Observatory.

people.name: Dax
people.line: Always in the kitchen. His sleeves smell of soup.

people.name: Bram
people.line: Quiet reader. Keeps library slips in his pockets.

people.name: Tansy
people.line: Kept a secret diary. Missing tonight.

people.name: Corvin
people.line: Clever, headphones always on. Missing tonight.

people.name: Wren
people.line: That is you. The seventh child, lost for thirty years.

gear.title: The Clock's Heart
gear.rule: A gear pair fits a gap when its two teeth counts add up to the gap.
gear.needKey: The Wind button needs the winding key. Find it in the Foyer.

alibi.title: Who Was Where?
notes: The person on the Roof was neither Dax nor Bram.
Isolde cannot bear heights. She was not on the Roof.
Dax's sleeves smelled of soup. He was neither in the Library nor in the Greenhouse.
Bram had a library slip in his pocket, but he was nowhere near the Greenhouse.

sight.title: The Telescope
sight.rule: Turn the dials until the lit window and the star sit inside the ring.

switch.title: Night-Watch Board
switch.rule: Each switch flips itself and the lamps above, below, left and right of it. Light all nine lamps.

pour.title: Vials of Stillness
pour.rule: Get exactly four drams into the big vial, then offer the dose.

sigil.title: The Vault Ring
sigil.rule: Find four different symbols in order. Gold ring: right symbol, right place. Silver ring: right symbol, wrong place.

tower.title: The Paradox Engine
tower.rule: Move all three rings from Past to Future. One ring at a time. Never put a bigger ring on a smaller one.

tock.t: The Headmaster is at the Engine's heart, Miss, in the second before he falls. The vial holds one clean freeze. Whatever you choose, it is yours.

credits: An original story, set in a school built like a clock.
